visualReview.notes: Principal connected Charlottenburg Palace exterior: open southern forecourt, long west Orangery/end pavilion and eastern New Wing, pale repeated facades/crossed glazing, red ceramic hip roofs/dormers/stacks, central three genuine arched portal recesses/thresholds/short treads and tall noble windows under a supported triangular pediment. Octagonal tower has arched window proxies/clock, ribbed copper bell/oculi, open lantern/cap and an original symbolic gilded Fortuna finial. Fitted extra facade bays over fragmented map edges and closed portico/stair footings in the same author/inspect/fix pass.

sharedSurfaceReview.notes: Seven roles use six existing256px shared graphs: plaster_lime, stone_limestone_raw, tile_ceramic, metal_copper, storefront and metal_painted. Neutral ceramic graph tinted red; painted metal supplies gold/dark accents. No embedded images/new graph/private atlas. One skyline draw, bounded textured draws, separate POSITION/NORMAL streams and equal CPU/GPU accounting. Every textured native run reads each graph once; unload releases geometry.

frameReview.method: Actually inspected52 current frames in nine labeled contact sheets plus final native forecourt/main pavilion, Orangery, drum/dome and portals at full resolution. Two ordinary pictures and standard PMTiles/Mapzen guided one author/inspect/fix pass. Added fitted facade bays where fragmented mapped edges had omitted windows, and closed column/stair footings to the same modest foundation. No bespoke terrain research.
